Operator KEYWORDS entries (||, ::) are non-words and give "" as documented (symbol). Tokens starting with @/$ are PARAMETER/symbol types -> ""; digit-start words are NUMBER (-> "") or, where a dialect allows digit-leading identifiers, VAR (an unquoted identifier, returned per the docstring).
